name: Kamnova for WooCommerce
author: kamalnath26

sections.description:
Bakery Delivery enhances WooCommerce by providing an easy-to-use delivery scheduling system for bakery and food ordering websites.

Customers can:
* Select delivery date and delivery time.
* Place same-day or future delivery orders.
* View live total price updates based on quantity.
* Enjoy a smooth checkout experience with delivery information saved to orders.

Store administrators can:
* Configure opening and closing hours.
* Set preparation time.
* Enable or disable same-day delivery.
* Configure business days.
* Control maximum same-day quantity and maximum order quantity.
* Configure delivery intervals and timezone.
* Enable complete uninstall options.
* Manage delivery settings directly from WooCommerce.

The plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and follows WordPress coding standards.

Features

  • Same-Day Delivery Support
  • Future Delivery Date Selection
  • Delivery Time Slot Selection
  • Preparation Time Management
  • Business Day Configuration
  • Product Delivery Controls
  • Live Quantity Price Calculation
  • WooCommerce Cart Integration
  • Checkout Delivery Details
  • Order Delivery Metadata
  • Customer Order History Support
  • WooCommerce Admin Order Support
  • HPOS Compatible
  • WooCommerce Settings Panel
  • Secure Nonce Validation
  • Translation Ready
  • Lightweight and Fast

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • PHP 8.0 or higher

sections.installation:
1. Upload the kamnova-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce → Bakery Delivery Settings.
  5. Configure your delivery settings.
  6. Enable Bakery Delivery for your products.
  7. Save the settings and start accepting delivery orders.
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Bakery Delivery is built specifically for WooCommerce.

Does it support HPOS?

Yes. The plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Can I configure delivery timings?

Yes. You can configure opening time, closing time, preparation time, business days, delivery intervals, and quantity limits.

Does the plugin modify WooCommerce templates?

No. The plugin uses WooCommerce hooks and follows WordPress best practices.

Is it translation ready?

Yes. The plugin supports WordPress translations.

Does uninstall remove plugin data?

Only if Complete Uninstall is enabled in the plugin settings.
